FE fundinfo Launches Product Mastering Core, Giving Investment Managers One Governed Source for Fund Data in Days
summary:
FE fundinfo today launched Product Mastering Core, a pre-configured, governed data layer that gives firms a trusted source for fund, share class and registration data, and sits at the starting point for connected workflows. 
Delayed launches, distribution errors and repeated reconciliation are rarely caused by the documents or filings themselves. They are symptoms of fragmented product data, disconnected workflows and multiple versions of the truth sitting underneath, with fund data traditionally spread across spreadsheets, in-house tools and departmental systems that were never built to talk to each other.
FE fundinfo’s Asset Managers Report 2026 found 65% of investment management leaders say this fragmentation limits their operational efficiency, and for 69%, the speed and accuracy of fund data shapes which managers distribution partners choose, and keep working with. Vendor consolidation is now the second-highest investment priority industry-wide, cited by 33% of respondents. Product Mastering Core replaces that fragmentation with one governed source of truth for fund, share class and registration data.
Key capabilities include:
Openfunds-aligned data model: More than 600 market-ready fields across umbrella, fund, share class and registration data, extensible with a firm's own internal codes and operational attributes.
Point-of-entry validation: Pre-configured Nexus validation catches errors before they reach downstream systems.
Change-event automation: Pre-configured Nexus rules flag related data at the point of change, catching inconsistencies before they reach downstream systems. 
Full approval workflow and audit trail: Every change is validated, approved and logged, showing what changed, when, and who approved it.
Fast time to value: Live in days, with no implementation project. New firms get 10 hours of consultancy and training, plus knowledge base access to get started.
A path to grow: Data, configuration and workflows carry forward as firms' needs evolve, so they can start small and scale without re-platforming.
Product Mastering Core is built for firms adopting governed product data mastering for the first time, or those who want a pre-configured, fast-to-implement entry point without a full implementation project. It complements Product Mastering, FE fundinfo's configurable solution for firms that need bespoke validation rules, workflow automation or dynamic pricing and holdings data. 
Product and operations teams create, validate and approve fund, share class and registration data directly in the platform. That data then flows into connected workflows across Nexus for Investment Managers, including document production, global funds registration, data dissemination and distribution, without a new integration for each one. Firms master the data once and use it everywhere.  
Data quality also shapes what firms can do with AI. FE fundinfo's research found 64% of investment managers believe AI will only deliver meaningful value once the quality and structure of underlying data improve. Product Mastering Core provides that governed, standardised foundation. 
Paul Poletti-Gadd, Head of Asset Management Products at FE fundinfo, said: 
“Most investment managers are still processing critical product information across spreadsheets and disconnected systems, which can slow launches and create inconsistencies. Product Mastering Core can be up and running in days rather than months, providing a trusted starting point for Nexus for Investment Managers.”
Cameron Smith, Head of Investor Disclosure at Valu-Trac Investment Management Limited, added:
"With Product Mastering Core, we have one reliable source of fund data to work from. This improves consistency, significantly reduces manual effort, and gives us greater confidence in meeting our regulatory and reporting requirements."
This launch reflects the wider vision behind Nexus for Investment Managers, which connects the data, technology and workflows behind the entire fund lifecycle.

content: FE fundinfo has launched Product Mastering Core, a pre-configured data layer designed to provide investment managers with a single source of truth for fund, share class, and registration data. Aimed at improving operational efficiency and reducing data fragmentation, the solution offers point-of-entry validation, change-event automation, and full audit trails. The platform can be implemented rapidly and serves as a foundational step for connected workflows and AI readiness within investment management.

Experian Launches Credit Cards App on ChatGPT, Offering a New Way to Discover Card Offers
summary:
Experian today announced the launch of the Experian Credit Cards app on ChatGPT, expanding its growing portfolio of AI-powered financial experiences and giving consumers a new way to discover and compare credit card options through a simple conversation.
"Consumers expect financial experiences to be as intuitive as the technology they use every day," said Debbie Hsu, Executive Vice President of Product, Experian Consumer Services. "By bringing our credit card marketplace into ChatGPT, we're making it easier for people to explore their options, compare cards with confidence and take the next step when the time is right. This is another example of how Experian is using AI to create simpler, more helpful financial experiences."
Consumers are increasingly turning to AI to answer financial questions before making important decisions. Whether they are looking for a cash back card, travel rewards, a low introductory APR or no annual fee, the research process often begins with a question. Until recently, finding the right answer typically meant sorting through search results, opening multiple browser tabs and comparing offers across multiple issuers’ websites. Consumer AI chat apps have enabled users to consolidate their search, and with Experian now managing offer detail display within ChatGPT, consumers can access accurate, consistent, and issuer-aligned offer information.
Bringing Credit Card Shopping Into the Conversation
Consumers want to understand which products fit their goals, whether they are building credit, earning travel rewards, reducing interest costs or maximizing everyday purchases.
The Experian Credit Cards app on ChatGPT helps simplify that decision. With only minimal input, consumers can review relevant offers from Experian's trusted partner network and compare the details that matter most, including annual fees, introductory bonuses, rewards rates, introductory APR offers and ongoing APR ranges, where available.
Each offer is presented with clear, consistent information, making it easier to evaluate options before continuing to Experian for offers matching their Experian credit profile. The experience in ChatGPT gives consumers an informed starting point and a faster path to finding a card that meets their needs.
"Our goal is to help consumers find credit card products that align with their financial goals and make those products easy to choose, get and use,” said Michael Coleman, Chief Marketing Officer at Credit One Bank. "Experian's Credit Cards app on ChatGPT creates a new way for consumers to discover and compare card options through a trusted, conversational experience. We're excited to be part of an innovation that helps consumers make more informed decisions before they apply.”
How It Works
Consumers who choose to take the next step can view offers matched to their Experian credit profile. Those who elect to receive offers are securely directed to the Experian website, where they can review eligible credit card offers. Experian members can also view any pre-approved offersii they are qualified for, and cards labeled No Ding Decline™iii, which won't affect a consumer's credit scoresiv, if they are not initially approved.
Advancing Experian's Consumer AI Strategy
The Experian Credit Cards app marks another step in Experian's strategy to bring trusted financial marketplaces into the AI platforms consumers are already using. From loans to insurance and now credit cards, Experian is building conversational experiences that help consumers move from asking financial questions to evaluating real financial products with greater confidence. By combining trusted marketplaces with AI, Experian is creating a simpler way for consumers to discover opportunities while maintaining transparency and consumer choice throughout the process.
Future enhancements are planned to include more personalized credit card experiences and expanded lender participation, continuing Experian's investment in AI-powered financial services that help consumers make informed financial decisions.

content: Experian has launched the Experian Credit Cards app on ChatGPT, allowing consumers to discover and compare credit card offers through conversational AI. The new tool simplifies credit card shopping by providing clear details from trusted partners, with options for users to securely transition to Experian's website to view personalized offers matched to their credit profile.
